title: A thin cone around a direction of density at least 1 has mass at least 1/2 in the unit ball (parent step 3)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ be a measure on the Borel sets of ℝ^P such that μ(λW) = λ·μ(W) for every λ > 0 and every open W ⊆ ℝ^P (where λW := {λx : x ∈ W}), and μ(B_1(0)) < ∞. Let σ ∈ ℝ^P be a unit vector, and let 0 < ρ < 1 satisfy ρ ≤ μ(B_ρ(σ)). Put K_ρ(σ) := ⋃_{t>0} B(tσ, tρ). Then 1 ≤ 2·μ(K_ρ(σ) ∩ B_1(0)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → μ ((fun x => lam • x) '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal lam * μ W) → μ (ball (0 : Euclid P) 1) ≠ ∞ → ∀ σ : Euclid P, ‖σ‖ = 1 → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 → ENNReal.ofReal ρ ≤ μ (ball σ ρ) → 1 ≤ 2 * μ ((⋃ (t : ℝ) (_ : 0 < t), ball (t • σ) (t * ρ)) ∩ ball 0 1)
